title: Local and Sparse Kernel Operator Learning for Incompressible Flows: An Operator Lagrange Formulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a local and sparse kernel method for learning the solution operators of incompressible flows. It builds on our earlier property-preserving kernel method, whose global output reconstruction and dense operator regression scale poorly. Our method replaces the global output reconstruction by local divergence-free interpolants with divergence-free polynomials of any degree, solved in parallel on the GPU. These interpolants are divergence free, periodic on periodic domains, and, with a multiscale kernel, approach Kolmogorov statistics under refinement. A compactly supported kernel, positive semidefinite in any input dimension, makes the operator regression sparse. Its support radius, and hence the sparsity, is fitted to data, and optional affine polynomials in the input capture global trends. Operator Lagrange weights join the two. translated_title: 面向不可压缩流的局部稀疏核算子学习：算子拉格朗日表述
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于学习不可压缩流解算子的局部稀疏核方法。该方法建立在我们早期的保性质核方法之上，后者因全局输出重构和稠密算子回归而扩展性较差。我们的方法用局部无散度插值替代全局输出重构，这些插值采用任意阶的无散度多项式，可在GPU上并行求解。这些插值是无散度的，在周期域上满足周期性，并且借助多尺度核，在细化过程中逼近Kolmogorov统计特性。一种在任意输入维度下均为半正定的紧支撑核使算子回归变得稀疏，其支撑半径（即稀疏度）根据数据拟合得到，同时输入中可选的仿射多项式用于捕捉全局趋势。算子拉格朗日权重将二者结合起来：每个新输入只需一次稀疏求解，并在输出重构之前作用于训练场。
tldr: 该论文提出一种局部稀疏核算子学习方法，用GPU并行求解的局部无散度插值替代全局重构，用紧支撑核实现稀疏算子回归，并通过算子拉格朗日权重高效结合两者，从而高效学习不可压缩流的解算子。
en_tdlr: A local and sparse kernel operator learning method for incompressible flows that combines GPU-parallel local divergence-free interpolants, compactly supported kernels for sparse regression, and Operator Lagrange weights for efficient learning of solution operators.
